description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 and FSSAI Packaging & Labelling Regulations.

requirements.title: Generic Name of Food Product
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a), Legal Metrology (PC) Rules 2011 / FSSAI Reg. 2.2.1
requirements.description: The common or generic name of the food commodity must be clearly printed on the Principal Display Panel indicating its true nature.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print the standardized generic food name prominently on the Principal Display Panel.

requirements.title: Manufacturer / Packer Name & Address
requirements.description: Name and complete physical address of the manufacturer or packer must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure manufacturer name, factory address, and corporate office details are clearly printed.

requirements.title: Best Before / Expiry Date
requirements.legal_reference: FSSAI Labelling Regulations / Rule 6(1)(d), Legal Metrology (PC) Rules 2011
requirements.description: 'Best Before' or 'Use By' date is mandatory for all prepackaged food products.
requirements.recommendation_template: Declare 'Best Before [Month/Year]' or 'Use By [DD/MM/YYYY]' clearly on the label.

requirements.title: Net Quantity (Weight / Volume)
requirements.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard SI metric units (g, kg for solids; ml, L for liquids).
requirements.recommendation_template: Verify net weight/volume in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, L) with correct font size.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price — MRP (Incl. of all taxes)
requirements.description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes must be declared in Indian Rupees.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print MRP in Indian Rupees with explicit 'inclusive of all taxes' mention.

requirements.title: Customer Service / Consumer Grievance Details
requirements.description: Customer care helpline number, email address, and postal contact for consumer grievances.
requirements.recommendation_template: Include customer service phone number, grievance email, and contact address.
